title: Debate Basics — Debate Structure
skills: identify the major parts of a formal debate
organize claims, evidence, rebuttals, and conclusions coherently
apply structured argumentation in speaking and discussion
alignment_note: Introduces the basic structure of formal debate, including organized claims, supporting evidence, responses to opposing arguments, and conclusions. Supports argument writing, oral communication, rebuttal, evidence use, and civil academic discourse across high school English courses.
